moods.mood_description: The Buddha gives his final teaching and passes into peace
What remains after the teacher is gone
The grief of the disciples at the passing of the master
Impermanence itself — the last change that comes to all
The final words: strive on with diligence
The disciples cling to the teacher; the Buddha points to the teaching
The body falls away, but the awakening does not die
The light that one man kindled for all mankind
The end of the man is the beginning of the teaching's echo
